h1: Extension audit with a prioritized fix list
overview: We review your extension from three angles: the code, the way people use it and your store listing. You receive a written report that ranks every finding by importance, covering security, permissions, speed, Manifest V3 readiness and store policy risks. Each point says what is wrong, why it matters and how to fix it. Standard and Premium add a 1-on-1 call where we walk through the report with you.

faq: Do you change anything during the audit?
No. An audit is read-only. You get a report and decide what to act on. If you want us to fix items, we quote that as a separate order in writing.
What do you need to run the audit?
The source code or the store link, plus read access to your store dashboard if you want listing data reviewed. We never need your password and only ask for view access.
Will the audit find every possible bug?
It covers the areas listed and highlights the most important risks, but no review can find everything. We state clearly what we checked and what we did not.
Can you check against store policy changes?
Yes. We compare your extension with the current Chrome Web Store program policies and flag risks such as broad permissions, unclear data use or missing disclosures.
